story.title: Florence Woman's Death Marks Seventh Alleged Femicide in Italy Since Mid-August
story.summary: Lorena Isceri, a 45-year-old woman, was allegedly abducted and killed by her ex-boyfriend, Federico Vella, in Florence. She was reportedly thrown off a motorway bridge after being forced into the trunk of his car. This incident is noted as the seventh alleged femicide in Italy since mid-August.

related_stories.title: Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial Results in Mistrial Due to Hung Jury
related_stories.summary: The murder trial of Lindsay Clancy concluded in a mistrial after the jury, which consisted of nine women and three men, was unable to reach a unanimous verdict following seven days of deliberation. The judge declared the mistrial after jurors indicated they could not come to a decision.

related_stories.title: Lindsay Clancy Jury Continues Deliberations Amid Tensions Over Holdout Juror
related_stories.summary: The jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial has entered its seventh day of deliberations, facing challenges due to a holdout juror who is reportedly not adhering to the court's instructions regarding reasonable doubt. The situation raises the possibility of a mistrial as the jury remains deadlocked.

related_stories.title: Leon Black Files Lawsuit Against House Panel After Skipping Epstein Deposition
related_stories.summary: Billionaire Leon Black has filed a lawsuit against the House Oversight Committee after failing to appear for a deposition related to the Epstein investigation. The lawsuit claims that the subpoenas issued by the committee, which required him to disclose nondisclosure agreements, are invalid.

related_stories.title: Russian Drone Attack Targets Ukraine's Security Service Headquarters in Kyiv
related_stories.summary: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine's SBU security service in central Kyiv on Friday afternoon, injuring five people, according to President Volodymyr Zelensky. The attack is seen as a significant escalation, with Zelensky accusing Moscow of targeting the personal office of the SBU head. He has instructed the SBU to respond appropriately to the strike.
